name: Yakhni Lamb Curry
instructions: 1. Blanch the lamb pieces in water, drain, and set aside. 2. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot and sauté whole spices (cardamoms, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaf). 3. Add the lamb pieces and sear until slightly browned. 4. Add enough water to cover the meat, add salt, and simmer until the meat is tender. 5. In a separate bowl, whisk the yogurt with fennel powder and ginger powder. 6. Slowly add the whisked yogurt mixture to the lamb pot, stirring continuously to prevent curdling. 7. Simmer on low heat for 10-15 minutes until the curry thickens and is infused with flavors. 8. Finish with a sprinkle of mace powder before serving.
description: Yakhni is a staple of the traditional Kashmiri Wazwan feast. It is distinct for its delicate, pale-colored yogurt gravy that avoids heavy spices, highlighting the natural flavor of the meat and the unique aroma of Kashmiri fennel and dried ginger.
